notes:
I don't have any notes on Psalm 89:27–52 to give you yet. I tried to read six sources: Enduring Word, Augustine's commentary on New Advent, Ellicott and Gill on Bible Hub, Precept Austin and the NET Bible notes. A coding error in my script stopped it before it showed me any of the text, and then I hit my limit on tool calls for this turn. So I haven't actually read any of those pages.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge, so I won't write anything from memory.

**If you reply "continue", I'll:**
1. Re-fetch the six pages above and pull out the comments on vv. 27–52.
2. Add the Pulpit Commentary (Bible Hub) and Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* (spurgeon.org or Bible Hub/StudyLight).
3. Look for notes from particular traditions on the passages where they're most likely to differ:
   - vv. 27–29 and 35–37: whether "firstborn" and the everlasting throne point to Christ.
   - vv. 30–34: God's discipline and whether His covenant can be broken.
   - vv. 38–45: the fall of David's royal line.
   - vv. 46–48: death and Sheol.
4. Check the Catholic and Orthodox sites and the modern-scholarship sites (Bible Odyssey, NET notes).
5. Write the notes verse by verse in your "v. 4: …" format, with the page URL after every point, and leave out anything I can't find.
